answer: Tenure-bound earning power resists sybils: each identity's reward multiplier grows only with its unbroken streak of answered epochs, and streaks are non-transferable. A farm of a hundred fresh identities earns the rookie rate on all of them, because the multiplier is earned in time, not bought with capital. Think of the ocean of submissions lapping at a wharf: the velvet rope cannot be jumped, since every new identity must wait the same queue before its share matures.
